content.short: Pulsar Finance is a crypto portfolio manager for tokens, DeFi and NFTs across 80+ chains and CEXs.
content.description: Pulsar Finance is a crypto portfolio dashboard that provides a global view of your assets—tokens, DeFi positions, and NFTs—across 80+ chains and centralized exchanges. It is designed for both newcomers and advanced users, helping simplify asset tracking by consolidating holdings from multiple platforms and delivering real-time updates to keep your portfolio current. This approach minimizes the need to switch between services and gives you a single, up-to-date snapshot of your entire crypto footprint. Whether you monitor wallets, exchanges, or DEXs, Pulsar Finance brings everything together in one place.
